paper: Financial Incentives and Performance: A Meta-Analysis of Experiments in Economics
engine: Agent-tool subagents (no Workflow tool on host)
central_tensions: Does the abstract/title overclaim relative to a design-stage-selected sample (researchers avoid contexts where incentives are expected to have large effects)?
Are the headline heterogeneity results sound given the BMA 'treats all observations as independent' while a dependence-aware method exists in the paper?
Is the single positive exception (lab + loss framing, PCC ~0.07) a robust discovery or a fitted, threshold-straddling, dependence-naive quantity?
Is preferring MAIVE justified beyond a single specification test, and is its instrument defined consistently?
Is the PCC a valid common currency across 88 heterogeneous experimental designs?
